name: Chief Magistrate of Mercadia
description: Ruler of Mercadia, who is killed by the end of the revolution.

timeline.summary: Gerrard negotiates with the Chief Magistrate to train the city's forces in exchange for help reclaiming the Weatherlight; Orim allies with Cho-Manno; the Caterans slaughter the Cho-Arrim.
timeline.quote: Gerrard agreed to train the city’s forces

timeline.summary: The Mercadians and Caterans betray the crew, capturing the Weatherlight and imprisoning them.
timeline.quote: the Mercadians and Caterans betrayed them, capturing the Weatherlight and imprisoning the crew once more
